name: Subwave by soum91
subtitle: Vizio sound bar, minus the Vizio app
description: Controls a Vizio sound bar straight over Wi-Fi (SmartCast) with the Tuya IR blaster as fallback: power, volume, inputs, every sound setting, presets, Google Cast now playing, Bluetooth, widgets, Control Center, Siri, and bar-off-with-the-TV on the Afterglow bridge.
